# Firebro

> A WebMCP-native production incident-response console. An AI agent investigates a live incident
> through structured, imperative and declarative WebMCP tools — service health, deployments, logs,
> traces, metrics, runbooks — while a human responder watches the same evidence in the same console.
> Production-changing actions (rollback, restart, scale, disabling a feature flag) require human
> approval, enforced server-side; record-changing actions (notes, opening a new incident) use
> declarative WebMCP forms so a human reads what the agent wrote before it lands. This is a
> deterministic simulation: no real infrastructure is reachable, and no action here has any effect
> outside this site.

## Tool surface

- 21 imperative tools registered via `document.modelContext.registerTool()`: 12 read-only
  investigation tools, 6 gated/state-gated action tools, and 3 human-control tools governing
  approvals.
- 2 declarative tools (`create_incident`, `add_incident_note`) exposed as `<form toolname="...">`
  elements — the agent fills the form, a human still presses Submit.
- The registered tool surface changes live with the selected incident, the console's role
  (`responder`/`observer`), the incident's state, and whether an approval is pending.
  `observer` registers no action or approval tools at all.

## Scenarios

Five deterministic incidents, selectable via `?scenario=` and reseeded via `?seed=` in the URL:
INC-4821 (bad deploy), INC-4822 (connection-pool exhaustion behind a decoy deploy), INC-4823
(runaway feature flag), INC-4824 (memory leak, no single failing span), and INC-4825 (third-party
provider outage — the correct response is to escalate, not remediate).

## Docs

Markdown docs live in the source repository, not on this origin — only the built console and its
static assets are served here, so these are absolute links rather than site-relative ones.

- [README](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/README.md): setup, both
  judge-browser test paths, scenario/seed parameters.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  system design.
- [docs/WEBMCP.md](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/docs/WEBMCP.md):
  how the tool surface is built and why.
- [docs/SECURITY.md](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md):
  the authorization model, including the seeded prompt-injection line in INC-4822's logs and why it
  changes nothing.
- [docs/SPEC-FEEDBACK.md](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/docs/SPEC-FEEDBACK.md):
  what building this taught us about WebMCP — four missing primitives and two implementation edges.
- [evals/RESULTS.md](https://github.com/PurpleWizard07/incident-commander/blob/main/evals/RESULTS.md):
  the eval suite, the tuned-vs-naive tool-description ablation, and what was not measured.
